$comment: Keccak-256 test vectors (original Keccak padding, as Ethereum and solc use). Shared by the unit tests and the browser smoke test. Digests: empty and abc as published with the Keccak reference and used across Ethereum tooling; the 200-byte input (0xa3 repeated) computed with js-sha3 0.8.0, the hash solc-js depends on, on 2026-11-03.

vectors.name: 200 bytes of 0xa3, more than one 136-byte block
